channel.description: Latest articles from Kenya Broadcasting Corporation (kbc.co.ke)

item.title: Likoni MP calls for swift action in tackling femicide cases
item.description: Likoni Member of Parliament Mishi Mboko has called for an urgent need to tackle the rising femicide cases.

item.title: PS Hinga defends Langata Affordable Housing Project, counters petition claims
item.description: Principal Secretary for the State Department of Housing and Urban Development, Charles Hinga has defended the Southlands Affordable Housing Project in Langata, insisting that all legal, environmental, and procedural requirements were fully met despite ongoing court challenges.

item.title: Inside Kshs 2 Billion plan to build Kenya's next generation of STEM professionals | KBC Digital
item.description: Strathmore University on Tuesday broke ground on the Kevin O’Byrne STEM Complex, a flagship investment valued at approximately Kshs. 2 billion aimed at transforming STEM education, research, and innovation in Africa. item.title: Africa challenged to fix health system inefficiencies to curb mortalities | KBC Digital
item.description: Health experts have raised concerns over the inefficiencies in the healthy systems in Africa alluding to it as a major contributor to high maternal and newborn deaths. item.title: Kenya Airways full year net loss climbs to Ksh 17B
item.description: Kenya's flag carrier, Kenya Airways has reported a net loss of Ksh 17.2 billion for the year ended December 2025 owing to supply chain disruptions which cost the airline capacity and revenue.

item.title: Tuju plea delayed after hospitalisation at Karen Hospital
item.description: Former Cabinet Secretary Raphael Tuju’s case at Kibera Law Courts on charges of giving false information to a police officer failed to kick off after he was admitted at Karen Hospital for treatment.

item.title: Counties seek Ksh 534B in equitable share
item.description: Governors are seeking Ksh 534 billion as an equitable share for the 2026/2027 Financial Year, as Senators warned of a worrying trend of pending bills in the devolved units.

item.title: Mozambique President Daniel Chapo in Kenya for three-day working visit
item.description: President Daniel Francisco Chapo has begun a three-day working visit to Kenya aimed at strengthening bilateral relations and expanding trade and investment between the two countries.

item.title: Court issues warrant of arrest against former Java CEO
item.description: A Nairobi court has issued a warrant of arrest against former Java Chief Executive Officer Derrick Cornelius Van Houten after he failed to appear for proceedings in a Ksh7.9 million fraud case.

item.title: 32 bodies recovered from Kericho mass grave, 25 confirmed to be infants
item.description: A total of 32 bodies have been recovered from a mass grave at Makaburini Cemetery in Kericho Town, with 25 of the remains confirmed to be infants.
